proc_p: Once the design is agreed, we plan making and installation around your timetable.
steps: We measure the space, look at how your team works and check services such as power and data.
You see the reception, meeting rooms and storage in 3D, with a quote that lists every item.
Desks, storage and panelling are made to your measurements in our workshop.
We install the joinery and can work alongside your builder, electrician and flooring contractor.
